images.name: WarehouseConcrete
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque square seamless tileable game albedo texture for a surreal industrial port warehouse with PS1 presentation. Primary request: Damp aged warehouse concrete, pale dirty gray green, salt bloom, sparse hairline cracks and dark mineral staining; fine irregular aggregate, medium low contrast. Composition: flat orthographic surface filling the whole square edge to edge; all four edges should tile. Lighting: uniform neutral diffuse illumination, NO directional shading, NO cast shadows, NO baked highlights. Restrained desaturated industrial color with medium readable surface variation. No objects, no text, no labels, no border, no perspective, no holes, no gore. Generate a single square material texture.
